# GitHub Copilot Instructions

> **Canonical Instructions Notice:**
> Repository instructions for AI coding agents, including GitHub Copilot, are
> maintained in the root `AGENTS.md` file.

Please refer to [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for repository setup, development,
testing, coding conventions and package guidance.

### Instruction updates

Do **not** add shared guidelines or best practices to this file. Update
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) directly so all coding agents use the same source of
truth. If this file ever conflicts with `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.md` is authoritative.
